title: Israel delays building contracts for West Bank settlement after UK sanctions
summary_full: Attorney general says E1 settlement decision should not be taken by caretaker government led by NetanyahuIsrael has postponed issuing contracts for the construction of a large settlement on the West Bank seen as likely to render a two-state solution unviable, days after the UK imposed sanctions against building firms operating in the area.Israeli diplomats insisted the move was not in response to the measures from Downing Street. Gali Baharav-Miara, the attorney general, said any decision on settlement expansion should not be taken by the caretaker government led by Benjamin Netanyahu but by whatever new administration was formed.
